scoring_justification: The verifier cannot re-run piecewise fitting on the full Zenodo dataset; the agent's final derived values (V_c and T_c) are compared to hidden paper-extracted gold values with tolerances that absorb typical fitting differences.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold values for critical lattice depths (V_c) and transition temperatures (T_c) from paper Figures 2-4, along with tolerances.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Figures 2-4 and reference solution solve.sh values; experimental errors reported in the paper.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper's experimental data points and stated error bars; tolerances set per verification plan (±1 Eᵣ for V_c, max(20 nK, paper error) for T_c).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the paper's own published results; no synthetic data is used.

outputs.description: Critical lattice depths determined from piecewise fits of coherent fraction vs. lattice depth. One row per (temperature, direction) pair.
Transition temperatures for six anisotropy points, determined from piecewise fits of coherent fraction vs. temperature.

output_contract.notes: Values are compared to hidden reference values from the paper using tolerances (±1 E_r for lattice depths, ±20 nK or experimental error for temperatures).
